scope: Stage 4b of the 1st development plan: zero-mode scan with a user decision step for unresolved candidates, and dimensionless finite-temperature LSWT quantities reusing the stored diagonalization (D25).

added.code-space/spintoolkit/observables/zero_: scan_zero_modes, ZeroModeReport, ZeroModePoint: classes zero / candidate / gapped from lambda_min(H(k))/scale; seeds at magnetic and primitive high-symmetry points and the lowest mesh points, continuous minimization, line probes, origin at k = 0 (goldstone / accidental / unknown)
added.code-space/spintoolkit/observables/therm: thermal_quantities, ThermalResult, ZeroModeCandidateError: F, U, S, C, boson numbers, moments, magnetization in t = k_B T / E0; existing kelvin routines reused through T = t / k_B

LSWTResult gains lattice, magnetic_lattice, thermal and hamiltonian_at; solve_lswt accepts a positive temperature; LSWTSettings.gapless records the user's decision

findings: The legacy boson-number kernel is correct at finite temperature: polarized ferromagnet <n> equals <n_B(omega)>, Neel equals an independent sum over paraunitary components.
Zero modes must be judged from lambda_min(H), not omega: lambda ~ Delta^2 / bandwidth, so an easy-axis gap of 9e-4 J (anisotropy 1e-7) already falls in the candidate band and is handed to the user.

J1-J2 square at J2 = J1/2: zero modes lie on lines; the shifted mesh cannot avoid them and solve_lswt without regularization reports 48 of 576 momenta. The scan (on a MAGSWT run) marks the off-centre zeros as lines.
LSWT boson numbers exceed S at high t; results there are flagged beyond_lswt with a warning.

ed_low_temperature.summary: F_ED - F_LSWT < exp(-2 Delta/t) and < 1e-3 exp(-Delta/t) for t <= Delta/5: the 0- and 1-magnon terms agree exactly, differences start at two magnons

decisions: D25 (2026-09-30): zero modes judged from lambda_min(H)/scale in three classes (zero <= 1e-12, candidate <= 1e-6, gapped); candidates stop finite-temperature quantities until the user sets gapless; gapless spectra report boson numbers, moments and magnetization at t > 0 as NaN while F, U, S, C are computed; scan points include magnetic and primitive high-symmetry points and mesh minima with continuous minimization and line probes; dimensionless t, no kelvin helper.
